description:
Select the frozen coding or elimination route whose actual row stride lies in the mid-range band, then record its current whole-consumer baseline.

## Background

Candidate routes include OSD syndrome/candidate work and coding materialization paths that call matrix parity or `row_xor`; the addendum names exactly one primary route after confirming its runtime stride. Setup, cloning, dispatch, and output costs remain inside the declared whole-consumer boundary.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The receipt identifies the selected production route, proves its actual stride is 8--64 words, and records raw samples, exact commands, input identities, append-only execution log, runtime provenance, and statistical interpretation.
- [hard] REQ-02: Seeded results match the canonical implementation for the declared boundary cases and remain deterministic under the measured execution configuration.
- [hard] REQ-03: Profiles attribute the route's material cost centers and state whether logical-buffer work is large enough to justify candidate confirmation.

## Notes

Run only in the benchmark window on the prepared host under the full-host wrapper.
